title: Average UK house price rises to record £299,331, says Halifax
summary: Increase of 0.3% in August marks third consecutive monthly rise, exceeding market expectations Business live – latest updates UK house prices rose for a third consecutive month in August, pushing the average price of a property to a record high as momentum returns to the market. Prices increased by 0.3% month on month in August – after a 0.4% rise in July and a 0.1% increase in June – pushing the average cost of a UK home to £299,331. Continue reading...

title: Thai Parliament Picks New Prime Minister but National Election Looms
summary: Anutin Charnvirakul, a conservative politician, secured enough support for the job only after agreeing to a demand from the liberal opposition to call for an election in months.
